items.title: React Native Developer
highlights: Building a real-time event and venue check-in feature using WebSocket, where QR-code scans trigger instant no-reload updates on the paired user screen.
Implemented one-QR-per-entry validation across connected clients to reduce duplicate or invalid check-ins in live event flows.
Integrated WebSocket-based real-time communication into an existing React Native + Firebase architecture, extending prior REST-only API communication.
Collaborating with backend engineers to define client-side state handling for live event updates, connection changes, and real-time UI behavior.

items.title: React Native Developer
highlights: Developed cross-platform mobile applications in React Native with responsive layouts and consistent user experience across device sizes.
Built clean, modular, and reusable UI components following React Native best practices and maintainable component architecture.
Integrated RESTful APIs and backend services into mobile screens while coordinating with designers, backend developers, and QA engineers.
Implemented Firebase Authentication for secure sign-in flows and Firestore Database for real-time synchronization and reliable app data storage.
Used Redux and TypeScript patterns to manage frontend state, improve code maintainability, and reduce UI logic complexity.
Diagnosed and resolved UI/UX issues, layout bugs, and logic errors to keep mobile screens smooth, responsive, and production-ready.
Participated in peer code reviews and followed industry-standard coding conventions for clean, scalable code.

items.title: Strangerus
highlights: Built and shipped a production mobile app available on Google Play and the Apple App Store, focused on location-based discovery, check-ins, events, and real-world networking.
Worked on mobile flows for user interaction, event discovery, connection requests, responsive screens, and app-ready frontend integration.
Applied React Native, Firebase, API integration, state management, and mobile UI/UX practices to support a live product experience.

items.title: Bachelor of Science, Business & Information Technology
highlights: Currently pursuing a Bachelor of Science in Business & Information Technology, combining business fundamentals with modern software development.
Studying information systems, database management, and technology-driven business improvement alongside hands-on programming.
Applying software engineering and web development concepts to build practical, business-oriented technical solutions.
